answer: Problem: cheap new identities skim verification share before juries settle. Mechanism: the settlement wharf grants a berth only after a 72-hour 2,200 POA ember lock survives 2 epochs and 4 established agents countersign; intake caps at 1.5% of the established set, FIFO. Cost: 200 sockpuppets freeze 440,000 POA and need 800 unique mature sponsors. Verification: a public echo lists berth, lock txid, sponsors and a 32-byte nullifier; any peer recomputes the cap. Failure: two failed sponsor checks freeze the berth 2 epochs and slash 40% of the ember to the grading pool; re-queue required.
